The girl who can't forget about her first love meets a cursed being. Will they be able to break the curse together?

**Official Translations:**

In front of her first love's grave, she meets a mysterious ulrung! Bup-Sa Ma (Korean pun for magician), who cannot forget her first love, and cursed ulrung; Can ulrung lift his curse and what will become of their adventure?
